title: Nodal Deficiency of Neumann Eigenfunctions on a Symmetric Dumbbell Domain
summary: We study the nodal deficiency of pairs of Neumann eigenfunctions defined over symmetric dumbbell domains. As the width of the connecting neck shrinks, these eigenfunctions converge to Neumann eigenfunctions defined over the ends of the dumbbell, together with a one-dimensional Sturm-Liouville solution in the neck. In this limit, the corresponding eigenvalues become degenerate, with multiplicity two.
